lines: Varied, giver, Your form shines — own-portioned, this world, difference fled;
to praise it, heart and speaking-songs be mine — rush unabandoned, evermore.
l4.sanskrit_cite: vividhaṃ te kila vapur vibhāti svāṃśe | tad evaitatstotuṃ hṛdayam atha gīrbāhyakaraṇaprabandhāś

verses.craft: Varied-shines; heart-and-speech vowed; evaitatstotuṃ joint per UNC (SD splits elsewhere).
